DEBUG
SYMPTOM: Auto-approved tool calls still prompt user for approval in Claude Code terminal. Worker shows correctly as typing/reading but Claude Code pauses anyway.
CAUSE: pre-tool-use route returns `{}` (empty body / 204) for safe commands. Claude Code treats an empty response as 'no opinion' — it falls back to its own permission system which then prompts interactively.
FIX: For auto-approved commands, return the full permissionDecision response:
```json
{ "hookSpecificOutput": { "hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "allow", "permissionDecisionReason": "Auto-approved: safe command" } }
```
This is identical to what the approval-toast Approve button sends, just emitted immediately without waiting for user input.
PREVENT: Always return explicit allow/deny. Never return empty from PreToolUse if you want to suppress Claude Code's own permission dialog.
FILE: src/app/api/hooks/pre-tool-use/route.ts — the autoApprove branch must return this JSON, not NextResponse.json({}) or NextResponse with status 204.
